question: Where should Spotify put the next quarter of product effort: access, usability, playback, or billing/support?

evidence.quote: Logged out of my account and the app is completely frozen on the loading screen. Uninstalled and re-installed as well as updated the app and nothing is working.

recommendations.rationale: The second-largest usability issue by complaints, and the one customers describe as the app not opening or getting stuck on loading.
recommendations.title: Fix app freezes and launch failures

evidence.quote: But even though the ad was over, the timer was still counting up.

recommendations.rationale: The largest usability issue by complaints and severity, so it carries the most weight in the usability roll-up.
recommendations.title: Reduce ad load and repeated-song complaints
